behavioral.label: get_model_scoreboard (auto-poll)
behavioral.evidence: invoke('get_model_scoreboard', { windowDays: SCOREBOARD_WINDOW_DAYS }) called in refresh() on mount and every RUNS_POLL_MS (10s). Result drives scoreboard state.

behavioral.label: list_gui_runs (auto-poll)
behavioral.evidence: invoke('list_gui_runs', { limit: RUNS_LIST_LIMIT }) called in same refresh() loop. Result drives runs table.

behavioral.label: get_routing_summary_live (auto-poll)
behavioral.evidence: invoke('get_routing_summary_live') called in refresh(). decision_preview?.selected_model shown in route-decision banner when non-null.

behavioral.label: get_gui_run (row click → detail panel)
behavioral.evidence: invoke('get_gui_run', { runId: selectedRunId }) fired in useEffect whenever selectedRunId changes. Sets fetchedRun, shown in detail Glass panel.

behavioral.label: Workflow name button → setSelectedRunId
behavioral.evidence: onClick={() => setSelectedRunId(r.run_id)} triggers the get_gui_run useEffect. aria-pressed reflects selection state.

behavioral.label: recordGamifyGuiEvent('workflow_completed') on completed runs
behavioral.evidence: Called only when gamifyEnabled=true (passed from parent). Guard checks rewardedRunIds ref to avoid double-firing. Partial because gamifyEnabled defaults false and caller must opt in.

behavioral.label: pushToast on load failure
behavioral.evidence: catch block calls pushToast({ tone: 'warn', title: 'Runs load failed', body: String(err) }). Genuine error reporting.

visual.issue: success_rate conditional uses raw Tailwind palette classes 'text-emerald-400', 'text-amber-400', 'text-rose-400' instead of design-token classes (e.g. ds-text-pass, ds-text-warn, ds-text-fail). These bypass the Limes token layer.
Error pre block uses hardcoded 'border-rose-300/20 bg-rose-950/20 text-rose-200' palette classes instead of design tokens. Last-error 'no error' text uses 'text-emerald-300' (line 254).

Route-decision banner renders selected_model in font-mono text-xs and all status fields as plain concatenated text with '=' separators (line 184-188). No semantic label/value grouping; cognitive hierarchy is flat.

Root div uses 'h-full overflow-auto' which makes the entire page scroll as one unit. At narrow viewports the 12-col grid stacks to 12+12 cols (each full-width) and the scoreboard table has no max-height/scroll — it expands unbounded before the outer scroll kicks in, causing the runs table to be pushed far off screen.

Workflow-name <button> uses aria-pressed but is semantically acting as a selection/navigation control, not a toggle. Should use role='option' inside a listbox, or a <tr> with aria-selected, rather than aria-pressed on a button inside a table cell.
Run detail Glass panel has no aria-live region or aria-label. When a user selects a run the panel appears/updates silently; screen readers get no announcement.

Quality score uses 'text-brass' — this is a Limes token, so acceptable — but rendered with 'font-mono font-bold' without any design-token class; verify 'text-brass' is in the Limes token scope (likely fine but flagged for consistency).

Run detail panel uses text-[11px], text-[10px] bracket sizes throughout — five distinct bracket sizes. Should use ds-* scale tokens (ds-text-xs, ds-text-2xs etc.) for consistency with the design system.
